	definition:
		obsDevice: Device = Device.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = contactsid),
		newDevice: Device
	precondition:
		Staff.allInstance()->exists(o|o.Id = contactsid)
	postcondition:
		let newDevice: Device in
		if obsDevice.oclIsUndefined() 
		then newDevice.oclIsNew() and
		newDevice.Id = id and
		newDevice.Name = name and
		newDevice.Location = location and
		newDevice.Contacts->includes(staff) 
		else obsDevice.Name = name and
		obsDevice.Location = location and
		obsDevice.Contacts->includes(staff) 
		endif 
}
